name: Massive Strikes (Monster)
body:
Prerequisite(s): Trample, Ability Focus (trample), size Huge or larger

Benefit(s): As a free action, you may choose to subtract 4 from your Armor Class for 1 round and when you successfully hit with a melee attack, your opponent must make a Reflex save (DC 10 + 1/2 your Hit Dice + your Strength modifier) or become flat-footed for 1 round. An opponent that fails its Reflex save against your trample attack is knocked prone in addition to becoming flatfooted for 1 round.
